results.q: I lost my internet connection while I was doing a transaction, what should I do?
results.a: Once you have an internet connection again, go to your wallet and see if the transaction was completed. If it does not show up in your wallet, then repeat your transaction

results.q: I don't think I got my 24 Circles Points per day, what should I do?
results.a: Check your wallet to see your balance history. Circles Points can arrive at different intervals, not necessarily every day. If your balance is wrong, please contact support.

results.q: My Circles transaction failed, but the Circles Points in my wallet decreased. How do I report this?
results.a: Check your wallet to see if the transaction completed or not. If there is no transaction there, then contact support.

results.q: It seems like I didn't get the right amount of Circles points during a transaction, how can I check?
results.a: Go to wallet, and check the historical transaction there
